methods.label: Check constant ratios and products
methods.explanation:
Direct proportionality has the form \(y=kx\), while inverse proportionality has the form \(xy=k\), with a fixed nonzero constant \(k\).

The alternatives can be rewritten as follows:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&y=-x,\\
\text{B: }&xy=\frac{10}{3},\\
\text{C: }&y=\frac{x}{5},\\
\text{E: }&y=\frac{x}{\sqrt3}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus A, C, and E describe direct proportionality, and B describes inverse proportionality. In E, the original denominator requires \(y\ne0\), which also forces \(x\ne0\); the direct relation holds on that domain.

For D, \(y=10-3x\). Both \((x,y)=(1,7)\) and \((2,4)\) satisfy this equation. Their ratios \(y/x\) are \(7\) and \(2\), and their products \(xy\) are \(7\) and \(8\). Neither quantity is constant, so D is neither directly nor inversely proportional. The answer is choice D.
